mechanism: hierarchical death scheduler, synced head phase, perpart death flags, active gating and rebirth reset
full_body_state_producer: Hydra owns4 body/leg/tail parts and7 head containers; each owns1 head+5neckparts. Parent aiStep explicitly ticks containers and bodyparts, thenpositionsbody. This is gameplay multipart, not one bone per server entity to copy.

Damage accumulator>120 enters DYING and endsCurrentAction; respawn140ticks starts only while DEAD. Controller enumDYING70→DEAD20 selfloop; BORN20→ROAR_START10→ROAR_RAWR50→IDLE. Seven indexed heads are one family, not7references.

Whole boss death has separate clock: tick1 disables respawn and ends active attacks intoIDLE, ticks20..140 every20 request one headDYING, tick200 removesparent. Head death, part death and wholeboss death cannot be conflated into one delay. Actual aiStep/death ordering has not been game verified, so no asserted full visual completion timeline.
controller_to_parts: Controller.tick first head.tick and allneck.tick; server advancesrespawn/state,headposition,facing,attacks,sounds; client mouthparticles; both animateHeadDeath thenneckposition. State mirrors into HydraHead DATA_STATE; mouthcurrent/previous have syncedfloats.

animateHeadDeath explicitly reads headEntity.getState(), not privatecurrentState, to consume syncedDYING onclient. Its localdeathTime markshead@1,neck0@10,neck1@20,neck2@30,neck3@40,neck4@50; otherstate resets localdeathTime0.

Each marked HydraPart increments own deathTime; at20 deactivates. Clientmarked+active addsPOOF/EXPLOSION. Parts tick beforenewmark, so marks and partdeactivation do not occur on samecontroller tick; no exact runtime stageclaim. This is progressive removal, not gravity-driven scatter.

HydraPart uses DATA_SIZEACTIVE andcached dimensions. Onsyncedactive restoration resets markedDead/deathTime; renderingreadsactive separately. Do not assume settingdimensions alone guarantees full hitbox restoration acrossversions; no native runtimecheck.
geometry_pose_and_display: HeadContainer stores perhead perstate necklength,x/yrotation,mouthopen and interpolates prev/current by ticksProgress/ticksNeeded. Dead/dying suppressesidlehead sway andtargetfacing. No projectile/contact timing changed.

Five neck transforms interpolate fromhead anchor tobody anchor at0,.25,.5,.75,1 withwrappedangles; lookingdown usesdifferentneckanchor offset. Geometry follows separatepartpositions; not a detachedmeshwith ownmomentum.

HydraHeadModel roothead→jaw/frill; mouthAngle subtractsheadpitch15degrees andjawopens60degrees atfullopen. Head renderType returnsnull wheninactive; necksubmit is gatedactive andneckflipDegrees0, whilehead inheritsTFPartRenderer deathroll. Differentpart display doesnotrequire samewholebodydeathpose.

HydraModel creates fake3heads andneckpieces as fallback; setupAnim calls super then resetsall skipDraw basedrenderFakeHeads, reenablesbody,alltailparts,legs andwriteslegangles. Hydra firstaiStep turnsfakeheadsflagfalse. This separates initialfallback visualgeometry fromlivepart renderers and rewritesshowstateeachdraw.
HydraRenderer no normaldeathflip. Shared512x256 atlaspath isbindingonly; noPNGcontentvieworcopiedtexture.

Headcontroller current/prevphase,ticksProgress,damageTaken,respawn/death clocks are notsaved inreadHydra methods or emptyHydraPart save methods.
